ctx.x: And you learned most your music by ear rather than by reading.

Yes. Yes, I did. That‟s true, I did. I wish I had been able to go to school and, and become a more educated… more educated in music as far as technically, you know. But uh, I never had that opportunity. And the kids today are very lucky because there‟re schools out there that teach jazz. I teach workshops with singers, jazz singers, kids, you know. And uh, at first, it was John Lewis got me that up at City College in 1978. I went up there and Eddie Summerlin, who was the head of the department at that time,…
